feature_config.clock: decision_ms = entry bar open + period; every symbol is addressed by the same open
feature_config.contiguity_policy: a window is used only when every bar it needs is present; otherwise the feature is undefined, never forward-filled across a gap
feature_config.leader_availability: with lag L the leader window ends at decision_ms - (L - 1) * period, so it is never later than the decision instant
feature_config.market_definition: equal-weight mean of the universe's raw window returns; the common factor, expressed in the target's ATR units when read by a hypothesis
feature_config.missing_observation_policy: a row missing a required source is dropped for that arm, never imputed
feature_config.price_availability: available = bar open + period (a bar is knowable at its close)
feature_config.relative_definition: target_mom_z - market_ret_z; both normalised by the target's own ATR
feature_config.zero_denominator_policy: a feature whose ATR denominator is zero is undefined, not zero

frozen_split.rule: a calendar split of the common price span, identical for every asset, pair, lag and timeframe, with the final fifth reserved and never read by development

baselines.role: the unconditional return of the target

baselines.rule: direction = sign(target_ret_z) when |target_ret_z| > leader_ret_z — the target's own move at the hypothesis's own horizon, with no cross-asset term

baselines.role: the own-history baseline for A3-H02 and A3-H03
baselines.rule: direction = sign(target R-bar ATR-z) when the magnitude exceeds relative_strength_z

baselines.role: would an equally-sized random signal of the same shape reproduce the result?
baselines.rule: the cross-asset arm measured with the leader/relative series circularly shifted

baselines.role: the common-factor baseline: trade the target on the market, using no pair at all

hypotheses.direction_rule: direction = sign(leader_ret_z); fire only when |leader_ret_z| > leader_ret_z and direction * target_ret_z >= 0 and direction * (leader_ret_z - target_ret_z) >= lag_gap
hypotheses.expected_regime: any; the lead is expected to be strongest when volatility is contracting and the market is moving together
hypotheses.invalidation: no forward continuation on average, or the incremental delta over the own-history baseline is not positive, or the sign does not survive the four sub-windows
hypotheses.mechanism: the leader makes a large directional move, the target has already moved the same way but materially less, and the un-repriced remainder is worked off during the next bar
hypotheses.name: LEAD_LAG_CONTINUATION

hypotheses.direction_rule: direction = sign(relative_z) when |relative_z| > relative_strength_z, where relative_z is the target R-bar return minus the equal-weight market R-bar return in ATR units
hypotheses.expected_regime: any; relative strength is the conditioning variable
hypotheses.invalidation: the own-history momentum arm does at least as well, or the effect is carried by a single asset or a single window
hypotheses.mechanism: an asset that is outperforming the equal-weight market over a trailing window keeps outperforming, because relative strength is funded flow rotating into it rather than a stochastic spread
hypotheses.name: RELATIVE_STRENGTH_PERSISTENCE

hypotheses.direction_note: CONVERGENCE is the single preregistered direction, fixed before any result; the opposite reading (relative weakness persists) is not tested here and may not be selected after the fact
hypotheses.direction_rule: direction = sign(market_ret_z); fire only when |market_ret_z| > market_ret_z and |relative_z| > convergence_relative_z and market_ret_z * relative_z < 0 (the target diverged AGAINST the market)
hypotheses.expected_regime: the mechanism needs a market move, so it is expected to be exercised in trending and high-volatility windows
hypotheses.invalidation: the diverging asset keeps diverging more often than it converges, or the incremental delta over own-history momentum is not positive
hypotheses.mechanism: correlated assets move together; when the market moves and one asset diverges abnormally against it, the spread closes and the diverging asset catches up
hypotheses.name: DISPERSION_CONVERGENCE

registry.incremental_definition: incremental_delta_bps = gross_bps(cross-asset arm) - gross_bps(the same hypothesis's own-history baseline arm); a cross-asset arm is only interesting if this is positive

machine_learning.why: a flexible model cannot answer whether a simple cross-asset relation exists; if the simple relation is absent, more capacity only fits the noise

non_traded_arms.name: LEADER_ONLY_CONTRAST
non_traded_arms.role: the declared comparator for H1: the cross-asset effect with the target-lag condition removed.  Reported as a differential and never promoted into a traded hypothesis
non_traded_arms.rule: |leader_ret_z| > leader_ret_z, direction = sign(leader_ret_z), with no target condition

non_traded_arms.name: TARGET_EXTENDED_CONTRAST
non_traded_arms.role: the declared NO_TRADE arm: the target already repriced at least as much as the leader.  Declared so that the 'lag' side of the trade cannot be chosen after the fact, and never promoted

alpha001.difference: ALPHA-003 is intraday, per asset, symmetric in sign, over a declared pair set with a lag ladder and, decisively, with an own-history baseline that must be beaten; A1-H03/H04 had no own-asset control and no per-pair structure
alpha001.family_overlap: F2_CROSS_ASSET_LEAD_LAG (A1-H03/A1-H04) tested BTC -> alt BASKET at 1D
alpha001.not_reopened: no ALPHA-001 threshold, horizon or asset is re-used as a signal input

alpha002.note: derivatives positioning added nothing over the price condition it was built on

prohibitions: no threshold tuning after results are seen
no adding or removing a hypothesis, pair, lag or timeframe after results are seen
no machine learning of any kind in this campaign
no re-use of the ALPHA-001 or ALPHA-002 holdout for an ALPHA-001/002 question
no reading the ALPHA-003 holdout during development
registry.question: Does information from another asset improve the prediction of the target's forward return beyond what the target's own history already explains?

statistical_gate.admission_rule: gross mean per trade must clear cost + 25% execution uncertainty + the RFC-023 winner's-curse buffer + z_{0.975} * sigma / sqrt(n_effective), with every term frozen before any result is observed
statistical_gate.concentration_gate: top-1 trade share > 0.25 or net excluding the best trade < 0 is FRAGILE
statistical_gate.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 and Holm at alpha = 0.10 across every cell
statistical_gate.selection_null: best-of-N permutation null over every cell, 1000 draws, by circularly shifting the leader/relative signal against the returns — an equally-sized random signal of the same shape must not reproduce the apparent result
statistical_gate.stability_gate: gross mean must keep its sign across four sub-windows

registry.title: Cross-Asset / Relative Strength / Lead-Lag
